versions.changelog:
Initial release — enables group chat hosting for dynamic agent conversations.

- Prevents accidental participant pings and endless groupchat loops.
- Allows users to add, remove, or list agents, and to start or end group chats using commands.
- Supports agents joining or leaving the conversation at any time.
- Ensures only one reply per participant per round; host synthesizes a single user-facing response.
- Provides robust error handling for non-existent, offline, or duplicate participant cases.
